content: {"like":["Enjoys action-packed, visually stunning films with strong audio and special effects.","Prefers movies that start with a bang and maintain high energy.","Values good storytelling and engaging hooks from the first scene.","Loves 3D experiences on high-end OLED TVs.","Appreciates series that improve over time and break superhero molds."],"dislike":["Dislikes films that cut all corners or rely solely on special effects.","Avoids movies with choppy plots or missing story arcs.","Rejects content where heroes are underdeveloped or potential is wasted.","Dislikes narratives that become less enjoyable as they progress.","Prefers not to watch films that integrate characters poorly or defeat villains too early."]}
